sections.name: ScaledSlide
sections.title: Scaling the slide to its box
sections.what: Measures the container width, works out the scale from the fixed 1280 width, redraws when the container changes size, and then shows the slide content scaled to fit.
sections.why: The comment states that the slide is drawn on a fixed canvas and scaled to the container width.
sections.watch_out: The scale is set only when the box is measured, so the effect runs once and relies on the resize watcher for later changes.

summary: Shows a slide designed for a 1280 by 720 canvas, shrunk or enlarged to fit its container while keeping its shape.
purpose: Lets a slide look the same at any width, so its layout does not change when the window is resized.
why: The comment says the slide is drawn on a fixed canvas and scaled to the container width. Likely reason: slide layouts depend on exact positions, so scaling keeps them correct.
how: 1. Waits for the container to appear. 2. Measures its width and works out a scale factor from the 1280 width. 3. Watches for resizes and measures again. 4. Draws the children at full size on the fixed canvas, then scales the whole canvas.
inputs: The slide content and an optional class name for the outer box.
outputs: A scaled slide area with a 16 by 9 shape.
risks: Nothing is drawn until the first measurement, so the area is blank for a moment on load.
debug: If the slide is blank, check that the container has a width. If the slide is cut off, check the fixed canvas size and the scale.
